romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: Announcement of a science fair at the school
Arav excitedly proposes to Riy that they create something amazing for the fair
Riy agrees and they decide to start the project immediately
event_chain.scene_goal: Establish the partnership between Arav and Riy to work on a project for the upcoming science fair
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the first scene, Arav and Riy now plan to start the project for the science fair

key_events: Arav and Riy decide to build a small robot together
The robot repeatedly catches fire and malfunctions
Riy calms Arav and promises to try again
event_chain.scene_goal: Show the initial attempt at building a robot and the challenges they face, setting up future perseverance
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the partnership established, Arav and Riy now attempt to build a robot but encounter frequent failures

key_events: Arav visits his grandmother and shares his concerns about his robot project
Grandmother gives him encouraging advice and reminds him that hard work never goes to waste and failure teaches lessons
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav receives emotional support and renewed determination to continue his robot-building efforts
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the initial attempt at building a robot and the challenges they face, Arav now seeks advice from his grandmother

key_events: Adhyapak Sharm checks all projects at the Vijnana Mela
He asks Arav how he made the robot and what its real use is
Arav calmly answers all questions and Sharm nods, praising his hard work
event_chain.scene_goal: Show Arav’s expertise and reinforce his confidence after receiving support
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Arav receives emotional support and renewed determination, Arav now answers questions about his robot

key_events: Announcement of the result and Arav and Riy’s team winning first place
Riy exclaims joyfully about the victory
Arav reassures that they will perform excellently
That evening both friends celebrate their win and thank their grandmother for her encouragement
event_chain.scene_goal: Reinforce Arav’s confidence and celebrate the team’s success while acknowledging the grandmother’s support
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Arav’s demonstrated expertise and reinforced confidence, Arav and Riy celebrate their first-place win

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: School mein upcoming science fair ka announcement hua hai, aur main soch raha hoon ki hum kuch extraordinary bana sakte hain.  
Riy: Haan, main bhi interested hoon. Chalo, turant project shuru karte hain.  
Arav: Shukriya, Riy. Hum aaj hi brainstorming session start karte hain.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: "Riy, chalo ek chhota robot banate hain, isse hum apni partnership ko practical bana sakte hain."  
Riy: "Haan, lekin pehle safety check kar lete hain; aaj ki machine baar baar jalti hai, shayad wiring mein koi problem hai."  
Arav: "Theek hai, main wiring ko dobara set karunga, aur jab phir se try karenge, hum isse sahi tarah se kaam karwa lenge."

neutral_script.dialogue:
Arav: Dadi, main apne robot project ke baare mein soch raha hoon, lekin abhi tak koi safal result nahi mila.  
Dadi: Arav, yaad raho ki mehnat kabhi bekar nahi jaati; har ek failure ek seekh hoti hai, aur aage badhne ka mauka deti hai.  
Arav: Shukriya Dadi, aapki baat se mujhe nayi himmat mil rahi hai.

neutral_script.dialogue:
Sharm: Arav, batao tumne yeh robot kaise banaya aur iska asli upyog kya hai?  
Arav: Maine pehle sensors aur microcontroller ko integrate kiya, phir programming se motion control aur obstacle detection set kiya; iska upyog educational workshops me students ko robotics sikhane ke liye hota hai.  
Sharm: Bahut accha kaam kiya hai, tumhari mehnat clearly visible hai.

Arav: "Haan, aaj raat hum celebrate karenge aur dadi ka dhanyavaad karenge unke support ke liye."

Arav: Shukriya Dadi, aapki baat se mujhe nayi himmat mil rahi hai.

## SCENE_04
*Location: Vijnana Mela (science fair)*

Sharm: Arav, batao tumne yeh robot kaise banaya aur iska asli upyog kya hai?
Arav: Maine pehle sensors aur microcontroller ko integrate kiya, phir programming se motion control aur obstacle detection set kiya; iska upyog educational workshops me students ko robotics sikhane ke liye hota hai.
Sharm: Bahut accha kaam kiya hai, tumhari mehnat clearly visible hai.

---

## SCENE_05
*Location: Unspecified, likely the celebration venue*

Arav: Result aaya, ekdum beast hai yaar, humne first place jeeta!
Riy: Kasam se bhai, kitna maza aaya! Yeh humari team ki shaan hai!
Arav: "Haan, aaj raat hum celebrate karenge aur dadi ka dhanyavaad karenge unke support ke liye."
